Definition: from G4383 and G2983; an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality:--respecter of persons.
BiblicalUsage: Prosopoleptes is a respecter of persons, one who favours a face. It appears once, when Peter opened his mouth in Cornelius's house: Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons, but in every nation he that feareth Him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter's discovery is the door of the gospel opening to the world: God never was a respecter of persons, and now Peter knows it.
